fit_reason: Private seller listing a whole 1998 Dodge Ram 2500 pickup, which we can detail.
findings: Black hood looks dull and blotchy rather than glossy in the night and wash-bay shots
Red paint on the front bumper and fenders looks flat and slightly faded in the wash-bay photo
Headlight lenses look hazy and yellowed in the wash-bay close-up
Black lower body trim/two-tone along the rocker area looks faded in the daylight side shot
No interior photos, so the cabin can't be judged
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 98 Ram 2500. The black hood and the red paint up front look a bit dull in the photos, and the headlight lenses look hazy. We do mobile pre-sale details, including a buff and headlight restoration, and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
